title: Transpantaneira
who: Classic route · the Pantanal's wildlife road
when: July to October for jaguars (dry season)
vehicle: Car or 4x4, 3–5 days with boat trips
summary: The MT-060: about 145 km of dirt road and over a hundred bridges (the wooden ones are slowly being replaced by concrete) from Poconé into the world's largest wetland, with caimans, capybaras, hyacinth macaws and jabirus all along it. At Porto Jofre the road ends; boats go up the rivers to look for jaguars. No fuel on the way.

sources.label: Estado de Minas: the dirt road across the Pantanal and its bridges (July 2026)

stops.name: Cuiabá
stops.text: The hot capital of Mato Grosso; bring cash, there are no ATMs further on.

stops.name: Poconé
stops.text: The gateway: the Transpantaneira starts at the arch south of town.

stops.name: Pixaim
stops.text: Lodges by the Pixaim river, giant otters and birds by the hundred.

stops.name: Porto Jofre
stops.text: The end of the road: boats into the Encontro das Águas park, famous for jaguars. Fires hit it in September 2025.
